title.narrative: WCUK: Monitoring Child Protection Violations in the Crisis in North Kivu, Nyiragongo and Rutshuru Territories

description.narrative:
The project aims to ensure the timely availability of reliable and coordinated information on the protection of children affected by the crisis in the territories of Rutshuru and Nyiragongo, for a period of six months.
To do this, the project will implement activities such as: - Capacity-building of local protection actors and DIVAS community child protection networks (RECOPE) in affected areas on protection monitoring, including on child protection and child safeguarding. - Coordinated collection and sharing of child protection incidents with humanitarian and state child protection actors. The protection risks to be monitored will be established jointly with child protection actors in the affected areas.
To ensure community engagement and the sustainability of project actions, the project will support the community protection networks (RECOPES) set up by the Division of Social Affairs (DIVAS), WCUK's state partner with the prime responsibility for social protection.
